name: Satyr Hooves
label: Quest
description: In Sen'jin Village, Ula'elek sends warriors north for Satyr Hooves. He needs their strange power to forge brutal gauntlets.

clips.title: The story
paras: In Sen'jin Village, Ula'elek sends warriors north for Satyr Hooves. He needs their strange power to forge brutal gauntlets.

Ula'elek sends you into Ashenvale's ancient woods to gather what his craft requires. Demonic corruption still clings to the satyr covens there, and he seeks more than iron and leather for armor meant to rival Kalimdor's fiercest forces.

In northeastern Ashenvale, satyrs feed on the forest's lingering purity and twist it into foul power. Those that take in the most develop swollen hooves without the usual cloven split. Ula'elek plans to draw out that concentrated magic and weave it into the gauntlets he makes.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: I can make you a pair of brutal gauntlets, and great magic will they hold. But first, you must collect this magic and bring it to me.

The satyrs dwell in northeastern Ashenvale because of the forest's power. They feed off its purity, leeching and corrupting. You can tell which satyrs have drawn the most of Ashenvale's magic by their swollen, uncloven hooves.
These hooves hold great power. I will need them for your gauntlets' crafting.

clips.title: Progress
paras: Do you have the hooves, friend? The magic within them is strong.

clips.title: Completion
paras: Ah, you have them! Now, just as the Satyrs leeched the strength of Ashenvale, I will leech the power held within these hooves and harness it into my crafting...
